WHO WE ARE
Three Founders. One Mandate: Built for Malaysia.

We are a team based in Klang Valley. We built Recycling Hub because Malaysian households and businesses deserved an e-waste collector that was registered, documented, and honest about what happens to your devices after pickup.

WHO WE ARE

Vision, Mission & Values
Vision
Mission
Core Values
Our Vision

A Malaysia where no old device ends up with an informal scrap dealer — every collection registered, every device accounted for, and every byte of data properly destroyed.

Our Mission

To make DOE-registered, fully documented e-waste collection the easy default — free for individuals, compliant and reported for businesses, and safe for your data either way.

Core Values

Compliance-First — Every collection — individual or bulk — is carried out under our DOE-registered status, with SW110 scheduled-waste compliance for business volumes. We do not run informal collection rounds.

Built for Malaysia — We operate under Malaysian e-waste regulation, not a generic global playbook — DOE registration, SW110 classification, and DuitNow payment, built around how collection actually works here.

Simplicity — Free doorstep pickup for individuals in Klang Valley, minimum 3 devices, no paperwork. Transparent quoting for bulk and enterprise collection. We eliminate the uncertainty that makes disposal feel complicated.

Data Security — Every data-bearing device goes through certified data destruction — physical, not a reversible software wipe — with a serialized certificate and full chain-of-custody tracking from collection to destruction.

What “Handled Properly” Actually Means

Every data-bearing device we collect gets a serialized certificate of destruction and a chain-of-custody record from pickup to processing — the exact paperwork an auditor, a compliance officer, or you would ask for if anything about that device were ever in question.

What e-waste is accepted?

Contact us about phones, tablets, laptops, computers, monitors and office IT equipment. Share a list or photos first, especially for appliances or unusual items, so the team can confirm acceptance.

Where is pickup available?
Household pickup and payment

Household e-waste pickup in Klang Valley is free for at least 3 devices per pickup. Business or bulk collections are quoted separately.
